_readme: 固定Benchmark测试集（阶段4）——人工标注的代表性声明，用于离线评测审查器。
documents: 模拟论文原文片段（英文，含精确句/连字符断行/数字/公式/多句等形态）。
cases: 每条 = 一个待核验声明。doc 引用 documents 的key，加载时展开为 full_text 与 evidence_text。
gold_verdict/gold_quote_alignment 为人工标注的地面真值，只用于评测，不参与模型判定。
gold_vote 计 20 例: supported 12 / unsupported 2 / contradicted 6；对齐 True 14 / False 6。
评测入口: python benchmark.py（产出写入 data/benchmark/benchmark_report.json）

documents.A: Surrogate gradient learning has emerged as the dominant approach for training spiking neural networks (SNNs) directly on the CIFAR-10 dataset. Our method, SpikeFormer, replaces the non-differentiable Heaviside spike function with a triangular surrogate whose slope is annealed during training. On CIFAR-10, SpikeFormer reaches 95.2% top-1 accuracy with only 4.6 million parameters, improving over prior state of the art by 1.8 percentage points. The model is trained for 300 epochs using the SGD optimizer with a cosine learning rate schedule. Notably, SpikeFormer achieves this accuracy without any attention modules, relying purely on convolutional blocks.
documents.B:
Memory footprint is a first-class concern for neuromorphic deployment. We evaluate our accelerator on the CIFAR-100 benchmark and report a 3.1x energy reduction compared with the GPU baseline. The proposed pipelining scheme overlaps weight fetching with spike com-
putation, improving overall perfor-
mance by 18% on average. Latency remains under 5 ms per inference frame at batch size one.
documents.C: Ablation studies on ImageNet-1k show that temporal coding contributes 2.3% of the total accuracy gain, while rate coding contributes 1.1%. The remaining 1.4% comes from the proposed dendritic branching. Training uses 8 NVIDIA A100 GPUs for 72 hours. All experiments are repeated 5 times with different random seeds; we report the mean.
documents.D:
The training objective combines cross-entropy with an L1 spike-rate regularizer:
    L = L_ce + lambda * sum_t || s_t ||_1 ,
where s_t denotes the spike map at timestep t and lambda = 0.01. The membrane potential update follows
    v_t = beta * v_{t-1} * (1 - s_{t-1}) + W x_t .
Gradient propagation uses the atan surrogate: dg/dv = 1 / (pi * (1 + (alpha * v)^2)).
documents.E: Motivated by homeostatic plasticity in biological neural systems, we propose Homeo-SNN, which adapts the firing threshold online. We hypothesize that threshold adaptation improves robustness to input rate drift; experiments in Section 4.2 support this hypothesis on the N-Tidigits dataset. We do not evaluate speech recognition on other corpora in this work. Compared with HDD, Homeo-SNN reduces latency by 23% under equal spike budgets. Limitations: the adaptive threshold adds 7% training-time overhead, and our study is restricted to small-scale networks (under 1M neurons).
documents.F: Large-scale validation: We train SpikingResNet on ImageNet-1k, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and DVS-Gesture. On ImageNet-1k the 34-layer variant attains 71.5% top-1 accuracy with 4.2 ms per-frame latency on the Loihi 2 processor. On DVS-Gesture it reaches 98.5% accuracy using only 3 timesteps. Training on ImageNet-1k takes 21 GPU-days on A100 hardware. All hyperparameters are listed in Appendix B; no data augmentation beyond random crop and horizontal flip is used.
